568866816BF16 native TorchTune model parameters and79308609FP32 originalMimi parameters, strict original checkpoint loading. BF16 is the supported create_model default; the repository CLI explicitly uses FP32. Torch2.11cu128 retained although Moshi declares Torch<2.10; unquantized workload validated here, not general compatibility.

Optional eager-only host position tracking requires exclusive cache ownership and update/reset as the only mutation paths. Caller supplies known initial position0 for ten newly allocated caches. Direct cache_pos mutations and torch.compile are unsupported when enabled. GPU K/V and position updates, resets and bounds enforcement remain.

GX skips arithmetic; scalar/list/CPU-array controls replay after original transfers and waits. Native plain latency restores all tensor/arange hooks; separate guarded native requests validate controls. GX output hashes are not numerical validation.

Baseline64native-only launches/request are FP32SGEMM and split-K reductions; isolated median sum1.114096ms is not an end-to-end correction. Zero prediction misses does not imply complete coverage. Candidate removes8320metadata kernels and4298device reads/request.
